questions.text: What are the disadvantages of multinational companies?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the disadvantages of multinational companies? (A)

answer.value:
Disadvantages
Maximum profit goes to the home country, which affects the interests of host countries.
Competition is destroyed in host countries, leading to monopoly.
They are accused of violating human rights. Resources in host countries may get depleted.
These companies often use methods to avoid paying taxes.
They exploit labour in host countries. They force host countries to invest more capital. Technology transfer is sometimes not appropriate.
They sometimes interfere in the political affairs of host countries.
